title: How a Garbage Disposal Works in 60 Seconds 🍋⚙️ #shorts
description:
A garbage disposal has no blades. A motor spins a plate with blunt impellers that fling food outward with centrifugal force against a rough grind ring, which grinds it into particles small enough to pass through its holes. Running water flushes it all down the drain. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#garbagedisposal #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Surprise: a garbage disposal has *no blades* at all.

steps.label: Motor
steps.text: An electric motor hidden under the sink spins a heavy *turntable* at high speed.

steps.label: Impellers
steps.text: Blunt metal *impellers* on that plate fling the food outward with *centrifugal force*.

steps.label: Grind ring
steps.text: The food smashes again and again against a rough, stationary *grind ring* on the wall.

steps.label: Tiny bits
steps.text: It's ground into particles small enough to slip through the ring's *tiny holes*, almost like a liquid.

steps.label: Flush
steps.text: A stream of running *cold water* flushes that slurry down the drain and out to the sewer.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Spin, *smash*, flush. Follow Inside 60 for more.
